violation_type.title: Children's Products- Posting of CPSC website (26 TAC §747.3935(c))
violation_type.short_title: Children's Products- Posting of CPSC website
violation_type.typical_finding: The operation did not have the required CPSC posting.

finding_variants.text: The operation did not have the required CPSC posting.
The operation did not have the children's product certification posting.    This was corrected at the inspection, a copy was provided, the form was filled and posted.
The CPSC form has not been signed and posted.
The required Consumer Product Safety Commission form has not been completed.
The operation did not have the CPSC website posted.
The operation does not have a current posting of the children's products.
